pages.name: Move-in
pages.what: Hand in what your church needs to move over: your people list, giving setup, files and the rest.

answers.q: Hand in something for the move
answers.a: Open the item, fill in its lines or press Choose files, then press Hand in. We look it over and mark it checked, or ask for a change with a note.

answers.q: Fix something we were asked to change
answers.a: The item shows We asked for a change with a note. Open it, fix what the note says, and press Hand in again.

answers.q: Save a move-in item and finish it later
answers.a: Fill in what you have and press Save for later. It stays as you left it until you press Hand in.

pages.name: My week
pages.what: See what is yours this week: your next thing, your assignments and the jobs you hold, day by day.

answers.q: Mark an assignment done
answers.a: Under Your assignments, press Done beside it. If you pressed it by mistake, press Not done to open it again.

answers.q: Say I am stuck on an assignment
answers.a: Press Stuck beside it, type what is in the way, and press Mark stuck. Whoever is over you can see it.

answers.q: Hear a walk-through of my week
answers.a: Under How your week goes, press Walk me through it. It plays each job you hold, day by day, and opens its page as you listen.
words: what do i do each day

answers.q: Move one of my jobs to a different day
answers.a: Under How your week goes, press Pick your days and choose the day each job falls on. Your week and the office team’s page follow it.
words: change which day i do something

pages.name: Office team
pages.what: See each office login’s week, what is late, and hand out assignments.

answers.q: Give someone an assignment
answers.a: Under Assignments, press Give an assignment in the person’s column. Fill in What, By when and Done when, then press Give it.

answers.q: See someone’s week the way they see it
answers.a: On their card under Each login, press See their week. It opens My week as that person, and nothing changes for them.

answers.q: Start a new person’s first assignment
answers.a: In their column under Assignments, press Start their first assignment. Their column then shows how far along they are.

answers.q: Send a stuck assignment up
answers.a: On the stuck item in the person’s column, press Send up. Whoever is over you hears about it.

pages.name: Needs you
pages.what: One list of what is waiting on you, worst first, with a button on each row.

answers.q: Change the order of the Needs you list
answers.a: Press Customize and use the up and down arrows to move a kind of work higher or lower. Untick one to hide it, then press Done.

answers.q: Deal with something on the list
answers.a: Press the button on its row, such as Review for something waiting on your approval, Send a reminder for an overdue bill, Reach out for someone under People to check on, or Open tasks for a late task. It opens the page where that work is done, or has Chief draft it.

pages.name: The week
pages.what: Read the church’s week on one page: Sunday, people and care, giving and messages waiting.

answers.q: See what the church needs this week
answers.a: Read the card at the top. It names the one next thing and has a button that opens the page for it.

pages.name: Reports
pages.what: See the year’s numbers for people, Sunday, groups, serving, giving, care and events.

answers.q: Make the annual report
answers.a: Pick the year, then press Make the annual report. Read the preview and press Print the annual report.

answers.q: Export the year’s numbers for a denomination form
answers.a: Pick the year and press Export the numbers. It saves a spreadsheet (CSV) with each number and where it came from.

answers.q: See an earlier year
answers.a: Beside The year, use the Year box or the arrows next to it. It shows this year and the four before it.

pages.name: Briefing
pages.what: Read Chief’s weekly letter on the church’s last seven days: Sunday’s count, new people, follow-up, the week ahead.

answers.q: Get a new weekly briefing
answers.a: Press Write a new briefing. Chief reads the church’s last seven days and writes a new letter, which opens when it is ready.

answers.q: Read an older briefing
answers.a: Press Older to go back one letter and Newer to come forward again.

answers.q: Talk the briefing over with Chief
answers.a: Press Discuss with Chief. Chief opens with a question about this week’s briefing already asked.

pages.name: This Sunday
pages.what: See the next Sunday, check it is ready, and open, rehearse or run it.

answers.q: Check that Sunday is ready
answers.a: The list called Ready for Sunday? shows what is left to fix. Press the button on a row and it opens where that fix is made.

answers.q: Run Sunday’s slides
answers.a: Press Run it on the next Sunday’s card. On a phone the same button says Remote.

answers.q: Start next week’s Sunday from this one
answers.a: Under the date of the Sunday after, press Copy this Sunday. It keeps the same order and leaves the songs and passages for you to pick.

pages.name: Order of service
pages.what: See the order for Sunday with times, who is on each item, and a note for each team.

answers.q: Print the run sheet
answers.a: Pick the service at the top and press Print the run sheet. It prints with a column for each team.

answers.q: Add a note for a team on an item
answers.a: Tap the item, press Add a team note, choose who it is For, type the note and press Save.

answers.q: Change the songs or items in the order
answers.a: Press Open in ChurchSavvy and change them in that Sunday’s plan. This page reads the same plan, so the change shows here.
words: add a song to the service

pages.name: Who serves when
pages.what: Fill the worship and production teams’ places for the next five Sundays.

answers.q: Fill the open spots for the coming Sundays
answers.a: Press Fill the next 5 Sundays (the number matches the Sundays shown). Chief asks people who are trained, free and not away, and you can press Take them back before anything goes out.

answers.q: Ask one person to serve
answers.a: Tap an open spot (it says + Fill), then press Ask beside a name in the list of who could take it.

answers.q: Mark that someone said yes in person
answers.a: Tap their spot and press They said yes. If they told you no, press They can’t and ask someone else.

answers.q: Offer a spot to the whole team
answers.a: Tap the open spot and press Offer it to the whole team. Everyone on the team who is trained and free gets it, and the first yes takes it.

pages.name: Kids check-in
pages.what: Check children into their rooms with a name tag and release them at pickup with a code.

answers.q: Check a child in
answers.a: On Check in, find the family by name or the last 4 of their phone, tick the children, choose Who brought them and press the Check in button. You get a pickup code and can print the name tags and pickup stub.

answers.q: Release a child at pickup
answers.a: On Pick up, type the Pickup code from the parent’s stub or text and press Look up. Tick who is going home, choose who is picking up, and press Release.

answers.q: See who is in each room
answers.a: Open In the rooms. Each room lists the children in it with allergies flagged, and you can reprint a tag or undo a check-in there.

answers.q: Start check-in when no service is set up yet
answers.a: Press Start this week’s check-in. It makes this week’s service in Services & Events, and you can check children in to it right away.

pages.name: Announcements
pages.what: Make announcements once, choose the days and screens they show on, and approve ministry requests.

answers.q: Make a new announcement
answers.a: Press New announcement, fill in the Title, The day it happens and Where it shows, then press Done. It shows on the days you pick and retires by itself the day after its last day.

answers.q: Approve an announcement a ministry sent
answers.a: Under Waiting for you, press Put it on. To edit it first press Change it first, or press Not this time to leave it off.

answers.q: Take an announcement down
answers.a: Open the announcement and press Take it off the board, then Take it off. It leaves every screen.

answers.q: Bring events in from the church calendar
answers.a: Press Bring in from the calendar. The events you bring over are added to the board.

pages.name: Bulletins & print
pages.what: Make the Sunday bulletin, a connect card, an invite card and a welcome flyer, then print them.

answers.q: Make the Sunday bulletin
answers.a: Pick Sunday bulletin and press Make it. It fills in from Order of service and the Announcements board, so change those first. Then press Print, print on both sides and fold the sheet in half.

answers.q: Make a connect card to print
answers.a: Pick Connect card and press Make it, then press Print when it shows. To change it, type a line under Anything to change? and press Make it again.

pages.name: Services & Events
pages.what: Plan each service or event: who is coming, who is serving, and which spots are still open.

answers.q: Add a service or event
answers.a: Press the Create button at the top of the page and fill in the form. The new one then shows under Upcoming.

answers.q: Set the serving roles a service needs
answers.a: On its card press Set up serving, or Roles if it already has some. Add each one with Add a role and press Save roles.

answers.q: Put someone on the roster
answers.a: At the bottom of the card, type a name or pick a member, choose Attending or a serving role, and press Add.

pages.name: Sundays
pages.what: Start, open, rehearse and run every Sunday’s plan, and keep your own templates.

answers.q: Start a new Sunday’s plan
answers.a: Under Start a new Sunday pick a starting point, such as a starter, Last Sunday again or A blank Sunday. Set the Name and when it Starts, then press Make the plan.

answers.q: Run a Sunday that is coming up
answers.a: Under Coming up, press Run beside that Sunday. Press the row itself to open its plan instead.

answers.q: Put a verse or song up without a plan
answers.a: Press the put something up on the spot link near the bottom of the page. When no Sunday is planned, the button at the top says Put something up now.

pages.name: Teams
pages.what: Set up the worship and production teams: their places, who is trained, and how often each serves.

answers.q: Add a Sunday team
answers.a: Press Add a team, pick a team you have or A new team, choose its usual places and press Add the team.

answers.q: Add a person to a team
answers.a: Open the team and press Add a person. Type their Name and Email, tick the places under Can serve on, and press the Add button.
words: put someone on the worship team

answers.q: Choose who is trained for a place
answers.a: Open the team and press Choose people on that place. Add people, mark each one Trained or Learning, and press Save.

answers.q: Limit how often each person is asked to serve
answers.a: Open the team and under Turns pick 1, 2 or 3 a month, or No limit. Chief never asks anyone for more when it fills the Sundays.

pages.name: Attendance & check-in
pages.what: Record who was at a service, by name and by headcount, and turn on Sunday check-in.

answers.q: Record Sunday’s headcount
answers.a: Pick the service at the top, then under Headcount type the number for each area or use the plus and minus buttons. Add another area, like Kids or Online, with the buttons underneath.

answers.q: Check someone in by name
answers.a: Under Check people in, type their name in the Find someone box and press Check in beside them.

answers.q: Add a first-time guest
answers.a: Under A guest, type their name, leave First-time guest ticked and press Check in. They are added to Members as a guest so someone follows up.

answers.q: Let members check themselves in on Sunday
answers.a: In the Sunday check-in card, set when the service starts and press Turn on Sunday check-in. Then press Download for the slide to put the code on your welcome slide.

pages.name: Check-in stations
pages.what: Set up welcome-desk tablets and family kiosks for kids check-in.

answers.q: Set up a check-in tablet
answers.a: Press Add a station, choose Welcome desk or Self check-in, set a Name and Station PIN, and press Add station and get a pairing code. On the tablet, open the station address shown and type the code.

answers.q: Pair a replacement tablet
answers.a: Press Pair a new tablet beside the station and type the new code on the tablet. The old tablet stops working at once.

answers.q: Change a station’s PIN
answers.a: Press the key button beside the station, type the new PIN (4 to 8 digits) and press Save PIN.

answers.q: Remove a lost or old tablet
answers.a: Press the trash button beside the station, then Remove station. That tablet can’t check anyone in after that.

pages.name: Volunteer teams
pages.what: Set up greeters, ushers, parking and other volunteer teams: places, who is trained, how often.

answers.q: Add a volunteer team
answers.a: Press Add a team, pick a team you have or A new team, choose its usual places and press Add the team.

answers.q: Add a volunteer to a team
answers.a: Open the team and press Add a person. Type their Name and Email, tick the places under Can serve on, and press the Add button.

answers.q: Choose who is trained for a place
answers.a: Open the team and press Choose people on that place. Add people, mark each one Trained or Learning, and press Save.

pages.name: Volunteer schedule
pages.what: Fill the volunteer teams’ places for the next five Sundays.

answers.q: Fill the volunteer spots for the coming Sundays
answers.a: Press Fill the next 5 Sundays (the number matches the Sundays shown). Chief asks people who are trained, free and not away, and you can press Take them back before anything goes out.

answers.q: Ask one volunteer to serve
answers.a: Tap an open spot (it says + Fill), then press Ask beside a name in the list of who could take it.

answers.q: See the worship teams on the same schedule
answers.a: Press Whole Sunday at the top. It shows every team to read, and each team is changed from its own page.

pages.name: Background checks & hours
pages.what: Track background checks for people who serve with kids or youth, and see serving hours.

answers.q: Record a background check that came back
answers.a: Under Background checks press Record beside the person, enter The day it came back clear, and press Record the check.

answers.q: Remind people whose check is due
answers.a: Press Send check reminders, then confirm. Each person gets a phone alert, an email or both, with your check link if you have set one.

answers.q: Add hours for a work day or a mission trip
answers.a: Under Outside the schedule press Add hours. Pick the person, the Day, the Hours and What they did, then press Add hours.

answers.q: Set the link people use to get a check
answers.a: In the small line under Send check reminders, press Change. Enter Your check link and press Save.

pages.name: Screen pictures & videos
pages.what: Keep the pictures and videos for Sunday’s screens: backgrounds, flyers and video announcements.

answers.q: Add a picture or video for the screens
answers.a: Press Add pictures or videos and choose the files. Pictures can be PNG, JPG or WebP up to 20 MB, and videos MP4, MOV or WebM up to 100 MB.

answers.q: Remove a picture or video
answers.a: Press the trash button under it, then Take it out. Any Sunday or look that used it shows nothing in its place.

pages.name: Worship setup
pages.what: Set up ChurchSavvy once: screens, the team, your look, songs, and phones and remotes.

answers.q: Add a song to the library
answers.a: Open Songs and press Find a song. Type the song’s name, bring the words in with Take a photo, Use a file or Paste the words, and press Add to the library.

answers.q: Add a screen or projector
answers.a: Open Screens and under Add a screen press the kind you have, such as In the room, Livestream or Lobby TV. Each screen gets its own link to open on the computer that drives it.

answers.q: Invite someone to the worship team
answers.a: Open Team and roles and press Invite someone. Enter Their name and Their email, then press Invite.

pages.name: Members
pages.what: See everyone on the roll, add people, and text, email or keep a note on anyone.

answers.q: Add a member or a guest
answers.a: Press Add a person, type the name, mobile and email, and choose A guest or A member. Press Add to the roll and their page opens.

answers.q: Bring everyone over from a spreadsheet
answers.a: Press Import at the top of the roll, press Choose a file and pick your spreadsheet. When it finishes, press Done and the roll shows the new people.

answers.q: Text or email a few people at once
answers.a: Tick the box beside each name, then press Text them or Email. Chief drafts one message to those people and shows it to you before anything sends.

answers.q: Keep a note on someone
answers.a: Open the person on the roll and press Note. Type what happened or what to remember, then press Keep the note.

pages.name: Member directory
pages.what: Turn the member directory on or off, see who is listed, and take someone out.

answers.q: Turn the member directory on
answers.a: Press the Off switch beside Member directory so it reads On, which only the owner can do. Members can then add themselves from the app.

answers.q: Take someone out of the directory
answers.a: Find the person under Listed and press Take out. Type a reason (they see it in the app) and press Take out of the directory.

pages.name: Families
pages.what: Keep each household, its children, their allergies and who may pick them up.

answers.q: Add a family
answers.a: Press Add a family, pick a parent or guardian, check the family name and press Add family. Then open the family to add the other parent, the children and pickups.

answers.q: Add a child to a family
answers.a: Open the family and press Add a child. Fill in the name, birthday, grade, usual room and allergies, then press Add child.

answers.q: Add someone allowed to pick up a child
answers.a: Open the family and find Also allowed to pick up. Type the name, relationship and mobile, then press Add.

pages.name: Groups
pages.what: See every group, who leads it and who comes, and log its meetings.

answers.q: Start a new group
answers.a: Press New group, pick the kind, give it a name, when and where it meets and how people join, then press Add group.

answers.q: Add someone to a group
answers.a: Open the group and type their name in the Add someone from Members box. Press Add beside the right person.
words: put a member in a group

answers.q: Record who came to a group meeting
answers.a: Open the group and press Log a meeting. Pick the day, tick who came (or press Everyone) and press Log meeting.

answers.q: Make someone a group leader
answers.a: Open the group, find the person under People and press Make leader. Press Make member to change them back.

pages.name: Classes & discipleship
pages.what: Write the church’s classes, add people to them and see how far each person has come.

answers.q: Start a new class
answers.a: Press New class, name it and choose how its lessons open. Or press Ask Chief to draft one and Chief writes the lessons for you to approve.

answers.q: Add people to a class
answers.a: Open the class and press Add people. It opens the class’s Students part, where you pick the person and press Enroll.
words: sign someone up for a class

answers.q: Publish a class
answers.a: Open the class and press Publish the class. If the button reads Finish the lessons to publish, press Edit lessons and write them first.

pages.name: Follow-up board
pages.what: See every guest who filled in a card, who has them, and which step they are on.

answers.q: Hand a guest to a leader
answers.a: Open the person on the board, choose a name under Hand to and press Hand on. Chief tells that leader.

answers.q: Mark a follow-up step done
answers.a: Open the person and press the Mark done button, which names their current step. Press Close when the whole follow-up is finished.

answers.q: Leave a note about a guest
answers.a: Open the person, type in Add a note for whoever has them and press Save the note. Tick Pastors only to keep it to the pastors.

pages.name: Visitor flow
pages.what: See everyone new in a period and how far each has come: back again, a member, serving, leading.

answers.q: See which new people nobody has reached
answers.a: Under Heard from someone, the names after Not yet are new people with no text, call, visit or email since they were added. Press Open Follow-up board to reach out.

answers.q: See how many new people came back
answers.a: The Coming back bar counts new people who came back or have gone further, such as becoming a member. Press a bar to list the people in it, and choose the period at the top.

pages.name: Prayer & care
pages.what: Read prayer and care requests in private, mark them prayed for, and hand one to a teammate.

answers.q: Read the prayer requests
answers.a: Open Prayer & care and press Open inbox. Requests show newest first, and only you and anyone you hand one to can see them.

answers.q: Mark a request as prayed for
answers.a: Open the request and press Mark prayed. You can also set where it stands with New, Reviewed or Closed.

answers.q: Hand a request to someone on the team
answers.a: Open the request and choose the person under Hand to. Only the church’s owner can do this, and that person then sees the request.

pages.name: Help requests
pages.what: Record requests for help, say yes to an amount, and record how the church helped.

answers.q: Add a request for help
answers.a: Press Add a request, pick what they need, add the amount and what is going on, then press Add the request. Tick Keep who asked private to hide the name.
words: someone needs help with a bill

answers.q: Approve a help request
answers.a: Open the request and, under Say yes, enter the amount in Approve up to and press Approve. Above the church’s limit, press Ask a keeper and enter the keeper’s 6-digit code.

answers.q: Record how we helped
answers.a: On an approved request press Record how we helped. Pick how you helped, the amount, the day and who it was paid to, then press the Record button.

answers.q: Set the help fund’s budget
answers.a: Under The fund press Set the budget (it reads Change the fund once one is set). Choose the fund, the amount each month and the most for one gift, then press Save.

pages.name: Shepherding
pages.what: Give every member family a shepherd and see who is drifting or not yet reached.

answers.q: Give families a shepherd
answers.a: On the Waiting for a shepherd card press Hand them out. Chief proposes who takes each family, and nothing moves until you press Approve and tell the shepherds.

answers.q: Move a family to another shepherd
answers.a: Press Open on the shepherd’s card and pick the family. Choose a name in the Move to… list and press the Move to button.

answers.q: Change how many families each shepherd has
answers.a: Under Who shepherds, find Families per shepherd and press the plus or minus beside the number.

pages.name: Who's drifting
pages.what: See regulars who have stopped coming, at church or at their group, so someone can reach out.

answers.q: Reach out to someone who stopped coming
answers.a: Find them on the list and press Check in with Chief. Chief drafts a short, warm note to them and shows it to you before anything is sent.

pages.name: Next steps
pages.what: Line up your cards and classes in the order people take them, from first hello on.

answers.q: Change the order of the next steps
answers.a: Press Arrange the road and put the cards and classes in order. Add any missing ones under Add to the road, then press Save the road.

answers.q: Invite people to their next step
answers.a: Open a step on the road and look at What happens next. Press Invite them with Chief and Chief drafts the invitation for the people who are waiting.

pages.name: Forms
pages.what: Make the cards guests fill in, such as a connect card, and share each by link or QR code.

answers.q: Make a connect card
answers.a: Press New card and, under Cards churches keep, press Add it on the card you want. It is made switched on, with its own link.

answers.q: Share a card with a link or QR code
answers.a: Press Open on the card and look at Where it lives. Copy its own link for a text or an email, or press QR code for the bulletin or a screen.
words: put a form on the screen

answers.q: Change the questions on a card
answers.a: Press Edit on the card, change the fields and press Save the card. A card that is part of your website shows Edit the page instead.

answers.q: Switch a card off
answers.a: Press Switch off on the card. Nobody can send it while it is off, and the answers you have so far are kept.

pages.name: Leaders & roles
pages.what: Name the church’s roles in your own words and ask people to hold them.

answers.q: Make a new role
answers.a: Press Make a role, type the title, pick the job it does, what it covers and who it answers to, then press Save the role.

answers.q: Ask someone to take a role
answers.a: Press Ask someone on the role (it reads Open once someone holds it). Under Who holds it pick the person and press Send the invitation.

answers.q: Give a leader a login
answers.a: Press Give a login on the Office logins row. It opens Settings, Team, where the church’s logins are set.

pages.name: Gifts
pages.what: Record cash, check and bank gifts, count each service, and keep the church’s books.

answers.q: Record a gift
answers.a: On the Giving tab fill in Record a gift: the amount, the day it was received, the giver, how it was given and the fund. Press Record gift.

answers.q: Record Sunday’s offering
answers.a: Under Giving by service press the service. Add a row for each gift under Add gifts, using Loose offering (plate cash) for cash with no name, then press Save gifts.

answers.q: Close the count for a service
answers.a: Open the service under Giving by service. Enter Cash counted, Checks counted and who counted, then press Close the count.

answers.q: Fix a gift that was entered wrong
answers.a: Find the gift in the Gifts list and press Correct, change it, type the reason and press Save correction. Online gifts are corrected through the payment provider.

pages.name: Payments
pages.what: Connect Stripe so people can give by card, then see what came in, when it reaches the bank, and refunds.

answers.q: Set up online giving
answers.a: Under Accept gifts online, press Set up Stripe here, or Connect Stripe if you see that button. Stripe handles the cards and pays the gifts out to the church’s bank.

answers.q: Refund an online gift
answers.a: Open the Gifts and payments tab, find the gift and press Refund on its row. A box opens where you set the amount and the reason, then press Refund.

pages.name: Recurring gifts
pages.what: See everyone who gives on a schedule, how much each month, and whose gift is late.

answers.q: See who gives every week or month
answers.a: Open Recurring gifts and press Active, Paused, Ended or All above the list. Each row shows the giver, the amount, how often, the fund and the next date.

answers.q: Follow up on a late recurring gift
answers.a: On a late gift press Ask Chief to reach out. The office cannot change a gift here: givers change, pause or stop their own gift in the member app.

pages.name: Pledges & campaigns
pages.what: Set a goal for a fund, record pledge cards, and watch real gifts fill it.

answers.q: Start a giving campaign
answers.a: Press New campaign and give it a name, a goal, the fund and its dates. Press Start the campaign, and gifts to that fund fill the goal on their own.

answers.q: Record a pledge card
answers.a: Press Record a pledge, choose the campaign and the person, and enter the amount as one total or an amount each time. Press Record the pledge.

pages.name: Year-end statements
pages.what: Email every giver their giving statement for the year, with the wording the IRS asks for.

answers.q: Send year-end giving statements
answers.a: Pick the Year, answer whether givers got anything in return for their gifts, then press the Email statements button. Nothing is sent until you press it.

answers.q: Get a statement to someone with no email
answers.a: The page counts the givers who have no email. Print theirs from each person’s page, or add an email to their record and come back.

pages.name: Giving health
pages.what: See how giving changed over a period, who gives again and where people come from.

answers.q: Compare giving with last year
answers.a: Set Period at the top, then set Compare with to Same time last year. The What changed tab shows what moved giving up or down.

pages.name: Find a grant
pages.what: Search open federal grants and keep track of the ones worth going after.

answers.q: Search for a grant
answers.a: Type what the church does in the search box and press Search. Results come soonest deadline first, each with What it pays and a link to read it on Grants.gov.

answers.q: Keep track of a grant
answers.a: Press Track this on the grant and it goes on your Grants board with its deadline. If you have no board yet, press Set up my Grants board.

pages.name: Store
pages.what: Set up what the church sells, such as books, shirts and retreat fees, and their prices.

answers.q: Add something to sell
answers.a: On the Store tab press + Add Item and pick what you are adding. Fill in the name and price, then save it.

pages.name: Giving page & funds
pages.what: Turn your online giving page on, set the funds people can give to and the amounts it suggests.

answers.q: Turn the online giving page on
answers.a: Under Your giving page press the Off button so it reads On. Press Copy beside the link to share the page.

answers.q: Add a fund people can give to
answers.a: Under Designated funds type the name in Add a fund and press Add. It saves right away, and the X on a fund removes it.

answers.q: Change the suggested amounts
answers.a: Edit the amounts under Suggested amounts, and the Page message if you want, then press Save.

pages.name: Money controls
pages.what: Make the church’s money view-only, so no new charges, refunds or payment links go out.

answers.q: Stop money moving through Solutionist
answers.a: Type a reason of at least 10 characters, press Enable view-only finances, then Confirm with password. New charges, refunds and payment links stop, and your records stay readable.

answers.q: Allow charges and refunds again
answers.a: Type a reason, press Allow financial actions and then Confirm with password.

pages.name: Approvals
pages.what: Read what Chief drafted and approve, edit or dismiss it before anything goes out.

answers.q: Approve a draft from Chief
answers.a: Open the draft, read it and press Approve. To approve several, tick each one and press the Approve button that shows the count.

answers.q: Change a draft before it sends
answers.a: Press Edit on the draft and make your changes. Press Save & Approve to send it, or Save, don’t send to keep the changes for later.

answers.q: Turn down a draft
answers.a: Press Dismiss on the draft. Nothing is sent, and it moves to the Sent back tab.

pages.name: Email
pages.what: Read and answer your church email, and write new email from your church address.

answers.q: Write an email from my church address
answers.a: Press New email, pick the From address, and type a name from your people or any email address. Write it and press Send, or press Draft with Chief to have it written from your notes.

answers.q: Answer an email
answers.a: Pick the message to open it. Choose the address under Reply as, write your answer and press Send.

answers.q: Turn on church email for the team
answers.a: The pastor opens the Church email tray and follows its three steps, ending with Give everyone their address. Each person on the team then gets their own church address here.

answers.q: Stop copies going to my own email
answers.a: At the top of Email press Copies to your own email so it reads off (on a phone it is in the mail menu). Your church mail is then read here in Email.

pages.name: Texts
pages.what: Text one person or everyone who said yes, and read the texts that come back.

answers.q: Text one person
answers.a: Press New text, type a name or number and pick the person. Write your message and send it.

answers.q: Send a text to the whole church
answers.a: Press Announcement, choose who gets it, write the message and press Review, then the Send button. Only people who said yes to your texts get it.

answers.q: Schedule a text for later
answers.a: In Announcement, under When, press Later and pick the time. Press Review, then the Schedule button.

answers.q: Get the church its own texting number
answers.a: Press the gear (Texting settings), then Get a number. Type your area code, press Look, choose a number and press Get this number.

pages.name: Member messaging
pages.what: Turn member chat on, choose who may use it, and name the safety officers who watch it.

answers.q: Turn member messaging on
answers.a: Open the Settings tab and press Turn messaging on. The button stays off until your safety officers are named, and only the owner can switch it.

answers.q: Name a safety officer
answers.a: On the Settings tab, under Safety officers, switch on Safety officer beside the person.

answers.q: Let a member use messaging
answers.a: On the People tab find the person and switch on Can use messaging. They need a birthdate on file first, and a teen needs a parent linked with Link a parent.

answers.q: Deal with a held or reported message
answers.a: A safety officer opens the Safety room tab and presses Deliver it or Remove on a held message. For a report, type what was done and press Close report.

pages.name: News & celebrations
pages.what: Post news to the member app, schedule it, and see who saw it.

answers.q: Post news to the church
answers.a: Press New post, choose who it is for and what kind, and write the title and message. Press the Post button and members see it on Home and News in the app.

answers.q: Schedule a post for later
answers.a: In New post, set When to Later and pick the time. Press Schedule it, and it shows under Coming up until it goes up.

answers.q: Send an urgent notice to phones
answers.a: In New post, switch on Important: ring their phones before you post. It rings the phones of the people it is for who have the app’s alerts on.

answers.q: Pin a post or take it down
answers.a: In the list of posts, press the pin on a post to keep it at the top, or the bin to take it down.

pages.name: Email Templates
pages.what: Set the signature and the wording Chief uses for its standard emails.

answers.q: Change the email signature
answers.a: Under Signature fill in the Name, Title, Phone and Email, then press Save changes. Chief signs every email it drafts with it.

answers.q: Change the wording of a standard email
answers.a: Under Templates open the one you want and edit the Subject and Body, or press Draft with Chief. Press Save changes.

pages.name: Notifications
pages.what: See what has happened lately and mark it read.

answers.q: Clear my notifications
answers.a: Press Mark all read at the top. Press Unread or All to choose which ones the list shows.

pages.name: Email setup
pages.what: Connect the church’s own domain so email goes out from your address, and check it is working.

answers.q: Send email from our church’s own address
answers.a: Follow the steps: enter Your domain, Send from and Display name, add the DNS records where you bought the domain, then press Send test email to prove it lands.

answers.q: Get help adding the DNS records
answers.a: On step 2, under Send the records to whoever manages your domain, type Their email and press Send records. They get the records to add for you.

answers.q: Check that email is working
answers.a: Open Email health and press Send a test. The test only goes to the address you sign in with, and the report shows whether it was delivered.

pages.name: Calendar
pages.what: See services, events, group meetings, booked rooms, tasks and birthdays on one calendar.

answers.q: See what is on this week
answers.a: Open Calendar and press Month, Week or Day at the top to change the view. Press an entry to open its own page, like a Sunday’s plan or a room booking.

answers.q: Put a meeting on the calendar
answers.a: On an empty hour press Schedule this hour, or on an empty day press Schedule a meeting. Chief opens with the day and time filled in and sets it up with you.
words: book a time with the pastor

answers.q: Add a service or an event so it shows here
answers.a: The calendar shows what other pages hold, so nothing is typed in here. Add a service or an event behind the Sunday door, a group’s meeting day in Groups, or a booking in Rooms & spaces, and it appears.

pages.name: Tasks
pages.what: Keep the office to-do list, with due dates and who each task is handed to.

answers.q: Add a task
answers.a: Type it in the box that says Add a task and press Enter or Add. Press Details first to set a due date, a priority or a member to link it to.

answers.q: Hand a task to someone
answers.a: Press Details when you add the task and choose the person under HAND TO. They find it on their own Tasks page under Handed to me.
words: give a job to a leader

answers.q: Mark a task done
answers.a: Press the box at the left of the task. It moves to the Completed list.

pages.name: Projects
pages.what: Track bigger jobs like the fall festival or the roof, with stages, hours and a budget.

answers.q: Start a project
answers.a: Press New project, name it, pick who it is for, the stage and a target date, and press Create project.

answers.q: Move a project to its next stage
answers.a: Press Board at the top and drag the project’s card to the next stage.

pages.name: Files & policies
pages.what: Keep bylaws, policies and member papers on file, and send a paper out to be signed.

answers.q: Upload a file
answers.a: Press Upload, drag the file in or click to browse, and press Upload again. Pick a person under Link to contact if the paper belongs to one member.

answers.q: Send a paper to be signed
answers.a: On the file’s row press the pen button (Send for signature), type the signer’s name and email and press Send. They get an email with a signing link.

pages.name: Rooms & spaces
pages.what: See who has which room, the van or the projector this week, and book or approve one.

answers.q: Book a room
answers.a: Press Book a room, pick the room, the date and the times, say what it’s for and press Book it. If your login can’t approve bookings, the button reads Ask for it and your ask waits for a yes.

answers.q: Say yes or no to a room request
answers.a: Requests show at the top under Waiting for a yes. Press Approve, or the Decline button beside it.

answers.q: Add a room, the van or equipment to the list
answers.a: Under The church’s spaces type its name, choose Room, Vehicle or Equipment and how many it holds, and press Add.

answers.q: Book a room every week
answers.a: In the booking sheet tick Every week and pick the date under Ends on. A weekly repeat runs a year at most.

pages.name: Rentals
pages.what: Keep outside bookings of the building, with the fee, the deposit and whether the bill is paid.

answers.q: Record a rental from someone outside
answers.a: Press New rental, pick the room and the time, and fill in the renter’s name, email, the Fee and the Deposit. Save it and it shows under Coming up.

answers.q: Send the renter a bill
answers.a: On the rental’s row press Send the bill. The bill is made in Bills, and Open in Bills takes you to it.

pages.name: Bills
pages.what: Bill someone for a rental, an event fee or speaking, and see what is still unpaid.

answers.q: Send someone a bill
answers.a: Press New bill, choose the person under Bill to, add a line for what it is for and the amount, and press Send bill. Save as draft keeps it without sending.

answers.q: Mark a bill as paid
answers.a: On the bill’s row press Mark paid. Remind has Chief draft a friendly reminder for one that is late.

pages.name: Supplies & equipment
pages.what: Count what the church keeps on hand, take in deliveries and keep a list of suppliers.

answers.q: Count what is on hand
answers.a: Press Count stock and enter how many of each item you have. Use Receive stock when a delivery comes in.

answers.q: Add a supplier
answers.a: Press the Suppliers tab, then Add a vendor, type the name and press Add vendor. Only the name is required.

pages.name: Check requests
pages.what: Ask for a check or a pay-back with its receipt, approve it and mark it paid.

answers.q: Pay someone back
answers.a: Press Add a request, enter the Amount, who gets paid, what it’s for and the ministry it comes out of, and add the receipt as a photo or PDF. Then press Add the request.

answers.q: Approve a check request
answers.a: The next request waiting sits at the top under Waiting for a yes. Press Approve with its amount, or Decline with a reason.

answers.q: Mark a check as paid
answers.a: Under Approved, not paid yet press Mark paid on the request. It goes into the books against its ministry, with its receipt.

answers.q: Set each ministry’s budget
answers.a: Press Limit & budgets, enter each ministry’s budget for the year and press Save. Add a ministry adds a new line.

pages.name: Church records
pages.what: Keep the register of baptisms, dedications, weddings, funerals and membership, and print certificates.

answers.q: Record a baptism, wedding or dedication
answers.a: Press Add an entry, choose what it is, add the people, the day, the Officiant and the Place, and press Add to the register.

answers.q: Print a certificate
answers.a: Find the entry in its year and press Certificate, then Print the certificate. In the print window pick your printer, or Save as PDF.

answers.q: Plan a baptism that has not happened yet
answers.a: Press Add an entry, choose It’s planned where it asks whether it has happened, and set the day. When the day comes, press Record it on the planned entry.

pages.name: Board & minutes
pages.what: Plan board meetings, take the minutes, record votes and look up past decisions.

answers.q: Set up a board
answers.a: Press Add a board, name it, choose how its quorum is counted and press Add the board. Then press Members & quorum on its card to add who sits on it.

answers.q: Plan a board meeting
answers.a: Press Plan a meeting, pick the board, the Day, the Time and Where, and press Plan it. Open items from last time come onto the agenda on their own.

answers.q: Take the minutes and record a vote
answers.a: Open the meeting and press Start the meeting, then type the minutes under each agenda item and press Record a decision for a vote. When it is over press End and send the minutes.

answers.q: Find an old board decision
answers.a: Press Decisions log and type a word from the motion, like roof or budget. You can narrow it by Board and Year.
words: when did we approve the roof

pages.name: Leaders note
pages.what: Read over the week’s note to every leader, add one win, and send it.

answers.q: Send this week’s note to the leaders
answers.a: Read the draft, press Write the win to add one thing that went right, then press the Send to button and Send now. Each leader gets their own email, and it goes once this week.

answers.q: Go back to the draft the app wrote
answers.a: Press Start from today’s draft, or Put back the draft under a part you changed.

pages.name: Monthly report
pages.what: Gather the month’s numbers for each lane, add your notes and send them to the pastor.

answers.q: Send the monthly report to the pastor
answers.a: Type a line under Your note for each lane and press Save note, then press Send to the pastor and Send now. It goes by email with your notes.

answers.q: Look at an earlier month
answers.a: Pick it under Month at the top of the page.

pages.name: Notes
pages.what: Jot down a thought, tag it as an idea, a to do or a question, and find it later.

answers.q: Write a quick note
answers.a: Type in the box that says Jot a note and press Note it. Chief guesses the kind, like idea or to do, and you can tap it to change it.

answers.q: Find an old note
answers.a: Type a word in Search your notes. Notes you archived are under Archive and stay searchable.

pages.name: Ideas
pages.what: Pin ideas on a board, link the ones that belong together and turn the good ones into tasks or goals.

answers.q: Put an idea on the board
answers.a: Type it in the box at the top and press Capture. On the Board view you can also double-click the board to pin a card where you want it.

answers.q: Turn an idea into a task
answers.a: Open the idea’s card and press Add to my tasks. It makes a real task, with the card’s date if it has one.

pages.name: Timeline
pages.what: Read the story of what the church set out to do, goal by goal.

answers.q: See what has happened toward each goal
answers.a: Open Timeline: each goal is a chapter with what was done under it. Press Refresh to read it again.

pages.name: Goals
pages.what: Set a target for members, giving or meetings and watch the progress toward it.

answers.q: Set a goal
answers.a: Press New Goal, say what you want to achieve, set the Target and the Period, choose what to count (new members, gifts received, meetings held) and press Save Goal.

answers.q: Mark a goal as reached
answers.a: Press Complete on the goal’s card. It moves to Completed.

pages.name: Your trackers
pages.what: See the trackers made for your church and ask Chief for a new one.

answers.q: Get a new tracker made
answers.a: Press Ask Chief to build one and say what you need to keep track of. Chief designs it, and it shows up here and in your menu.

pages.name: Make a tracker
pages.what: Describe what you need tracked, or pick the fields yourself, and make the tracker.

answers.q: Make a tracker yourself
answers.a: Choose Describe It and tell the builder what to track, or Build Manually to name the fields yourself. Press Make the tracker to save it.

answers.q: Change or pause a tracker
answers.a: Find it in the list of your modules at the top and press Edit, or Pause to stop it for now.

pages.name: Program results
pages.what: Show how a program like the food pantry is helping, and prepare a report from the records.

answers.q: Make a report on how a program is helping
answers.a: Press Set up report and choose the tracker that holds sign-ups and the one that holds dated readings. Then press Save report snapshot, and a manager or the owner approves it before it is exported.

pages.name: Sermons
pages.what: Add each message with its video or audio link, group them by series and publish them to your site.

answers.q: Add Sunday’s message
answers.a: Press Add a message, type the Title, the day it was preached, the Speaker and the Video link, and press Save and publish. With Show it on your site turned off it is saved as a draft.

answers.q: Start a sermon series
answers.a: In the message form press the New series button beside Series, name it and press Save. Edit series on the page changes or removes one later.

answers.q: Make short clips from a sermon
answers.a: Press Make clips. It opens Clips, where you upload the recording.

pages.name: Live
pages.what: Go live with the stream you already use so members watch in their app with a chat.

answers.q: Go live on Sunday
answers.a: Under Go live type what’s live, paste your stream’s link, choose the service it counts as attendance for and press Go live. Members watch it in their app.

answers.q: End the live service
answers.a: Press End live, then Yes, end it.

answers.q: Look after the chat while live
answers.a: Beside a message press Hide, Pin or Pause. Type in Message as Host to speak to everyone, or press Close chat to shut it.

pages.name: Video studio
pages.what: Describe a video, shape the scenes with Chief, add your photos and make an MP4.

answers.q: Make a short video with Chief
answers.a: Press New video, name it, type your idea, pick the shape and press Create with Chief. Review the scenes, then press Create video and download the MP4 when it is ready.

pages.name: Video Clips
pages.what: Upload a sermon recording and get short captioned clips with covers, ready to post.

answers.q: Cut clips from a sermon recording
answers.a: Press Choose a video, tick I have the right to use this recording and press Upload. Then press Find my best clips, and you get a notification when they are ready.

answers.q: Cut one clip yourself
answers.a: Press Cut one yourself, give the clip a name, type the Start and End in seconds and press Create draft clip.

pages.name: Media Library
pages.what: Keep the church’s photos and logos in one place for the website, emails and print.

answers.q: Add a photo
answers.a: Find the spot it is for, like Hero Banner or About Photo, and press Drop or click to upload. For the gallery press Add image.

answers.q: Keep a gallery photo off the website
answers.a: Press Edit on the photo in the gallery and untick Show on website.

pages.name: Devotionals
pages.what: Write a devotional series and send it to your members a day at a time.

answers.q: Write a devotional series
answers.a: Press New devotional, give it a Title, press Add a day for each day and fill in its Scripture and The words, then press Publish. Members see it in the Bible tab of the app.

answers.q: Paste in a devotional you already wrote
answers.a: Open Paste in a devotional you already wrote and paste the whole thing, with each day starting on its own line as Day 1, Day 2 and so on. Press Read it.

answers.q: Take a devotional down
answers.a: Open it and press Take it down. It is a draft again and members no longer see it.

pages.name: Bible reading plan
pages.what: Choose the Bible reading plan your members follow in the app and the day it starts.

answers.q: Start a Bible reading plan
answers.a: Choose one under Plan, set the day under Starts and press Start this plan.
words: read the bible in a year

answers.q: Stop or switch the plan
answers.a: Press Stop the plan, or pick another under Start a different plan and press Switch to this plan.

pages.name: Marketing
pages.what: Plan the week’s posts with Chief, approve each one and see what went out.

answers.q: Approve this week’s posts
answers.a: On This week each draft says Waiting for you. Press Approve on one, or the Approve all button, and it goes out at its time.

answers.q: Write a post
answers.a: Press New post, type the Caption, pick a picture and the accounts under Goes to, and press Save for my OK. It waits on the desk until you approve it.

answers.q: Have Chief plan the week’s posts
answers.a: On This week press Plan the week now. Chief writes the posts and makes their flyers, and they show up as drafts for your OK in a minute or two.

answers.q: Stop a post from going out
answers.a: Press Skip on a draft, or Take back on one you already approved.

pages.name: Create
pages.what: Make a post, a flyer, a video or clips from a recording.

answers.q: Make a flyer
answers.a: Press Flyer, type what the flyer is for and press Design it with Chief. Chief tells you in the chat when it is ready, and it lands in your library for the Post tab.

answers.q: Write a post for our accounts
answers.a: Press Post, type the Caption, pick a picture and the accounts, and press Save for my OK. Nothing goes out until it is approved on the marketing desk.

pages.name: Posts
pages.what: The older plan for your posts. Marketing has taken its place on the menu.

pages.name: Social Media
pages.what: Connect the church’s social accounts, see where each post went and draft post ideas.

answers.q: Connect our Facebook or Instagram
answers.a: Under Your social accounts press the network’s button below Connect an account and sign in on the network itself. You come right back here with it connected.

answers.q: Get help with the words for a post
answers.a: In the box under Need words, type what you want to share, pick the Platforms and a Tone and press Draft posts. Press Post in Create on the one you like.

pages.name: Outreach
pages.what: Have Chief draft an email or text series toward a goal, then read it and launch it.

answers.q: Send an email or text campaign
answers.a: Under New campaign type the goal, choose who it goes to and press Draft it with Chief. Read the messages, then press Launch and Confirm launch.

answers.q: Pause or delete a campaign
answers.a: Press Pause on one that is running. To remove one, press Delete and then Yes, delete.

pages.name: Get found
pages.what: Work through a short list of steps that help someone looking for a church find yours.

answers.q: Work through the steps to be found online
answers.a: The page shows your next step with a button to start it. For a step on Google or Instagram, follow the numbered steps, press Copy link to take the website link with you, then press I’ve done this.

pages.name: Testimonies
pages.what: Ask people for a testimony, and keep their words to show on your website.

answers.q: Ask someone for a testimony
answers.a: Under People to ask, press Ask for a testimony beside the person and Chief drafts the note. If nobody is listed, press Ask someone. Press Mark asked if you already asked them yourself.

answers.q: Add a testimony someone gave us
answers.a: Under Saved testimonies press Add a testimony, paste their words exactly, type their name and press Save. Leave Show on website ticked to mark it for the website.
words: put a testimony on the website

pages.name: Website
pages.what: Build the church website with Chief, change its words and photos, and put it online.

answers.q: Change words on the website
answers.a: Press Edit in the bar above the page, tap the words and retype them. Edits save as you go, and you press Done when you are finished.

answers.q: Change a photo on the site
answers.a: Press Edit and tap a dashed photo frame to drop in a new photo. Site photos, under More, lists every photo spot on the site.

answers.q: Take the site offline or bring it back
answers.a: Press the Live or Offline button in the site bar and choose Take site offline to edit or Bring site back online. While it is off, visitors see a “we’ll be right back” page and nothing is deleted.

answers.q: Use our own web address
answers.a: Press Live in the site bar and choose Use your own domain, then type the address and press Connect. Add the records it shows at your domain provider and press Verify.

pages.name: Links
pages.what: Set up one page that holds all the church’s links, to share in a bio, a text or on a card.

answers.q: Turn on our link page
answers.a: Tick Enable link page and press Save. Then press URL to copy its address, QR for a code or Preview to see it.

answers.q: Add a link to the page
answers.a: Under Custom Links type a Label and the address and press Add, then press Save.

pages.name: Meetings page
pages.what: Share a page where people book a meeting with the pastor or the office, and set the hours.

answers.q: Set up a page where people book a meeting
answers.a: If the church has no page yet, press Ask Chief to set up booking. Chief builds it from your hours, and you review it before anything goes live.

answers.q: Share the link for booking a meeting
answers.a: The page opens on Share. Press Copy beside the link, and press the Not published button so it reads Published and the link works.

answers.q: Set the hours people can book
answers.a: Press Availability, set your Weekly hours and any Blocked dates, and press Save.

answers.q: Connect my own calendar so I’m not double booked
answers.a: Press Availability and find Use the calendar you already have. Paste your Google, Outlook or iCloud calendar’s private link and press Connect, and only your busy times are read.

pages.name: Brand Studio
pages.what: Set the church’s colors, fonts, logo and voice, used on the site, emails and print.

answers.q: Change the church’s colors or fonts
answers.a: Open the Look tab and change the Palette or the Type. Your edits are kept as a draft until you press Review and publish in the bar at the bottom.

answers.q: Upload our logo
answers.a: Open the Mark tab and press Upload on the Primary logo plate. The other logo shapes are drawn from it.

pages.name: Member app
pages.what: Turn the member app on, choose its look and pictures, and control how members sign in.

answers.q: Turn the member app on
answers.a: Press the Off switch at the top so it reads On, then press Copy to share the address. Members sign in with a 6-digit code sent to their email or phone, with no password.

answers.q: Change the pictures in the app
answers.a: Under Pictures in the app press Change pictures and choose the photo for each spot. Under Who else can change them you can add your media team.

answers.q: See the app the way a member does
answers.a: Under Preview as a member use Find a person, choose someone and press Open preview. It opens their week, groups and giving without a code.

answers.q: Sign everyone out of the app
answers.a: Press Sign everyone out, then Yes, sign everyone out.

pages.name: Events page
pages.what: Turn on the public page where people sign up for your events, and share its link.

answers.q: Turn on event sign-ups
answers.a: Press the Off switch beside Your events page so it reads On, then press Copy to share the link. Only events set to Public show on it.

pages.name: Logins & areas
pages.what: See who has each part of the church, and set what each office login sees and does.

answers.q: See a new login after inviting them
answers.a: Logins are made in All settings: open Your church, then Team, type their email, pick Their lane or a role and press Invite. They then show here on the Office logins tab, where you set what they see.

answers.q: Change what a login can see
answers.a: Open the Office logins tab and press Change beside the person, or Give areas if they have none yet. Tick every area they work in and press Save.

answers.q: See the app the way another login sees it
answers.a: On the Office logins tab press See as beside their name. Press Back to yours when you are done.

answers.q: Change who does a job
answers.a: Open the Duties tab, press Move beside the duty, or Name someone if nobody has it, pick the login and press Save.

pages.name: About your church
pages.what: See what Chief knows about the church and talk it through to fill in the rest.

answers.q: Tell Chief about the church
answers.a: Press Talk it through with Chief. It is a conversation of about fifteen minutes, and you can pause any time and pick it up where you left off.

pages.name: Integrations
pages.what: Connect the outside services the church uses: email, the bank, card payments and social accounts.

answers.q: Connect email
answers.a: On the Email tile press Set up email, or Open Email setup once it is started. It takes you to Email setup, where the sending address and the inbox are connected.

answers.q: Connect the church’s bank
answers.a: Under BANK CONNECTION press Connect Bank and sign in to your bank. Its transactions then come into the books.

pages.name: Autopilot
pages.what: Choose how much Chief’s helpers do without asking, and see what ran by itself.

answers.q: Choose how much runs without asking
answers.a: Under Autonomy pick Manual, Smart or Full Auto for Overall, or on one helper’s card. Full Auto asks you to confirm before it turns on.

answers.q: See what ran by itself
answers.a: Scroll to Activity and open the Autopilot Log for the last 7 days.

pages.name: History
pages.what: Look up everything that was done in the church’s account, by whom, and what failed.

answers.q: See what was done and who did it
answers.a: Type what you are looking for in the box and press Find. Press Failures only to see what did not go through.

answers.q: Undo something Chief did
answers.a: History shows what happened and has no Undo button. Press Ask Chief at the top of the page, and Chief lists what it did lately that it can take back.

pages.name: All settings
pages.what: Find any setting: logins, your plan and bill, the look, notifications and Chief.

answers.q: Change our plan or see the bill
answers.a: Open Money and plan, then Billing and plan. Next bill shows the date, Switch plan on a plan’s card changes your plan, and Manage Subscription opens Stripe for your card.

answers.q: Change the look to light or dark
answers.a: Open Look and feel, then Appearance. Under the design you like press Light or Dark.

answers.q: Give someone a login
answers.a: Open Your church, then Team, type their email, pick Their lane or a role and press Invite. Set what they see afterwards in Logins & areas.

answers.q: Find a setting
answers.a: Type its name in the box at the top that says Find a setting and press the result. Or type what you want changed and press Ask Chief.

answers.q: Change the words the app uses
answers.a: Open Your church, then Your words, and press Edit your words.

pages.name: Help Center
pages.what: Find how to do something, see what has changed, and write to us.

answers.q: Write to the Solutionist team
answers.a: Open Help Center and press Write to us. A person answers, and your messages and our replies stay together under Your messages.

answers.q: See what has changed in the app
answers.a: Open Help Center and look under What’s new. Press Everything that has changed to read every upgrade, newest first.

pages.name: Solutionist Academy
pages.what: Work through an eight-course planning program with a coach, one session at a time.

answers.q: Start or continue a course session
answers.a: Find the course marked NOW STUDYING and press Enter the Lecture Hall. Each session is a conversation with the coach, and your progress is kept.

pages.name: Bring a file over
pages.what: Turn spreadsheets from your old system into trackers here, with their rows brought in.

answers.q: Bring in a spreadsheet from our old system
answers.a: Press Choose CSV files and pick the files you exported. Chief shows what it made of each one, and nothing is saved until you check it and press the Build it and import button.

answers.q: Paste a list instead of a file
answers.a: Press No file? Paste a list instead, paste one row per line with commas between the columns, and press Use this list.

pages.name: Resources
pages.what: Keep a list of guides, worksheets and videos the church shares, free or behind a form.

answers.q: Add a resource to share
answers.a: Press Add Resource, type a Title, paste its link, choose Free or Gated under Access and press Add.
